Hi, I'm Li Na, Head of Product at our mobile gaming studio. We just closed out Q3 2025 (July–September) and I need to formally wrap up our user retention initiative for the quarter.

I've put together a summary brief in `q3_retention_initiative_brief.txt` in the workspace — it has the three key results we committed to, our starting baselines, targets, and what we actually achieved by end of quarter.

Could you please:
1. Set up a proper tracking record for this initiative in our goal-management memory system, including the cycle, owner (me, Li Na), and all three key results with their baseline and target numbers.
2. Log the final actual results we achieved for each key result.
3. Close out the initiative as completed.
4. Write a thorough end-of-quarter review covering what we accomplished, what went well, where we fell short, lessons we can reuse in future quarters, and what we should do differently next quarter.
5. Give the overall initiative a rating.

Please make sure everything ends up saved properly in our goal-tracking memory file.
